layers.purpose: Keep every acquired provider response immutable for replay and audit; never repair or overwrite source evidence.
layers.storage: data/runtime/private-landing/<source>/<run-id>/ with manifest hash and source pointer

layers.purpose: Parse source facts into typed observations with a deterministic dedupe key and explicit rejection reason.
layers.storage: private normalized batch plus market_source_effective_observation pointer
layers.mysqlPolicy: typed observation plus payload hash and private pointer

layers.purpose: Store one confirmed printing identity and dated population, price, sale, FX and image metadata facts.
Derive daily market cap, ranks, change windows, tracked-sales aggregates and alerts from canonical facts only.

identity.matchPolicy: exact_all_fields; card_language is identity-bearing and splits otherwise identical canonical printings; ranking boards may remain language-combined; no first-search-result, guessed suffix or padding

trackedSales.bundlePolicy: exclude_bundle_from_unit_price_and_reference_price; retain only explicitly split quantity and unit value

timestamps.effectiveAt: provider event or market date used for history and window anchors
timestamps.fetchedAt: CARDZ acquisition time; never replaces effectiveAt

currency.native: retain native value and ISO currency alongside USD
currency.fx: use dated FX observation; never rewrite historical USD values with today's rate
